routing.when_to_use: Prepare structured interview plans and consistent competency-based scorecards for one role and interview loop.
when_not_to_use: A different task requires its own task-specific skill
Unapproved signature, external communication, system mutation, or final authority
Required evidence or authorization is unavailable
exclusion_rules: Missing facts block only dependent conclusions; complete separable work
No inferred company policy, jurisdiction, law, or approval
ambiguity_rules: Read authorized supplied evidence first; ask only material unanswered questions

forbidden_actions: Unapproved external effects, signatures, legal commitments, or source-system mutations
Inventing facts, jurisdiction, company policy, legal authority, or approval
Exposing personal/confidential data beyond authorized task scope
verification_steps: Inspect and cite authorized source material; distinguish facts, interpretation, assumptions and unresolved questions.
Complete all separable work; identify exact missing fact, owner and effect on conclusion.
Validate the task-specific output schema, review boundary and empty external-effects/mutations lists.
Use native read/write/toolcard mappings only; report unavailable approved interfaces without inventing calls.
completion_criteria: Task deliverable meets typed contract and task-specific acceptance criteria
Evidence, uncertainty, jurisdiction/applicability and owner decisions are visible
No unapproved external effects or system mutations
known_limitations: Structural qualification is not semantic or legal certification
The pack is draft and uncertified; owner qualification/admission remains external to this adaptation

telemetry.retention_policy: retain opaque task/source ids and hashes only
